issues.where: crops 1, 2 and 4, the whole inside of the glass in the shaken state (also set-B-03.jpg crop 7 and set-B-01.jpg)
issues.what: the shaken particles are long, even 1 to 2 px straight streaks that cross each other at random angles, all equally sharp at every depth. They read as straw or hair, not as grains moving fast, and none near the glass or far behind is out of focus
issues.fix: draw shorter streaks that curve with one swirl and vary in width and brightness. Blur the near and far ones into wide soft smears, and keep some flecks as sharp tumbling flakes

issues.where: crop 11, the pond (also set-A-02.jpg crop 5 and set-B-02.jpg crop 5)
issues.what: the pond shows bright neutral-white patches (about 215 RGB) where the sky behind it is a dim warm grey (about 80). In A it is white under an amber glow, so the water mirrors something that is not in the scene
issues.fix: make the water reflect the real scene (sky, trunk, lamp post, lanterns), keep each reflection dimmer than what it mirrors, and break it up with small ripples

issues.where: crop 10, the white band at the edge of the ground seen through the bottom of the glass (also set-A-02.jpg crops 3 and 5, set-A-03.jpg crop 9, set-C-03.jpg crop 11)
issues.what: the band is a stretched, blotchy white and grey noise texture like camouflage, with a smooth top edge. It has no grains, crystals, sparkle or relief, and the pond runs straight into it
issues.fix: replace it with modelled sand or snow: fine grains with relief and a few glints, a soft drift-shaped top edge, a shadow where the grass meets it, and a low bank in front of the pond

issues.where: crops 8, 10, 11 and 12, the sea glass set into the base (also set-B-02.jpg crop 5)
issues.what: the sea glass pieces are flat, opaque fills of colour with a soft gradient and no translucency, frosting, bright edge or highlight. Next to the well-modelled shells they look like painted plastic
issues.fix: give the sea glass a frosted, see-through material: light glowing through it, bright thin edges, fine pitting, a soft highlight, and a seat shadow in each recess

issues.where: crop 12, the top edge of the sand heap right of the base (same in set-B-03.jpg crop 12)
issues.what: a 1 px saturated magenta line (about RGB 235,45,130) runs about 90 px along the ridge where it meets the dark background, and the ridge ends on a hard, smooth outline
issues.fix: remove the fringe from the antialiasing or chromatic aberration pass and break the ridge silhouette into loose grains

issues.where: crop 10, the large stones around the pond
issues.what: the large stones are smooth, pillow-shaped lumps with a soft blurry texture. In the close-up they look like a low-detail model next to the fine grass and the small stones
issues.fix: use higher-detail rocks with displacement, cracks and grain that match the small stones, and seat them with contact shadow

issues.where: crop 12, where the glass meets the base on the right (also set-A-03.jpg crop 9)
issues.what: on the right, the sphere ends on a clean hard line against a flat, sharp-cornered pale wedge of the base lip, with no seat and no dark contact line. The left side has a dark seat ring (set-A-02.jpg crop 3, set-C-03.jpg crop 9), so the two sides do not match
issues.fix: run the dark seat ring all the way round, round off the corner of the wedge, and add a thin shadow line where the glass enters the base

issues.where: crop 6, the haze around the trunk and lanterns (also crops 3 and 5)
issues.what: the pale haze ends on razor-straight edges with sharp corners a few px off the trunk and branches. It reads as cut-out cards, because the edges do not soften as they move away from the trunk
issues.fix: soften these edges with depth fade or a penumbra that widens with distance from the trunk

issues.where: crop 12, the falling sand (also set-A-03.jpg crops 9 and 12, and the grass tips in set-C-03.jpg crop 9)
issues.what: the falling sand is a curtain of sharp, round dots in one tone with no motion streak, though the particles inside the glass are streaked in B. The edge of the stream and the grass tips against the bright haze carry 1 px magenta and blue fringes
issues.fix: add a slight vertical streak that grows with fall distance, vary grain size and tone, and remove the colour fringes

issues.what: the petals and leaves are flat shapes in one colour each, with no curl, overlap, veins or texture on the seed head
issues.fix: add petal curl and overlap with some tonal variation, a textured seed head, and veined leaves

issues.where: crop 6, the cottage roof and chimney (also set-A-02.jpg crop 3)
issues.what: nothing has settled on the roof, chimney cap, fence or lamp, though gold flecks crowd the tree's crown. The shingles are painted lines on a flat plane, and the chimney pot is a plain black box
issues.fix: settle a few flecks on the roof, cap, rails and lamp top, give the shingles thickness and shadow, and give the chimney pot a rim

issues.where: crops 10 and 11, the mirror image under the base
issues.what: the reflection is as blurred at the contact line as it is far away, and a bright hotspot in the reflection under the base matches no light above it
issues.fix: keep the reflection sharp at the contact line and blur it with distance, and remove the hotspot or tie it to a visible light

issues.where: crop 1, inside the glass at the upper left (about x 265 to 310, y 268 to 290 in the crop)
issues.what: a thin, dark, straight line about 50 px long reads as a hair or a crack in the glass
issues.fix: remove it, or give it a seed head so it reads as a dandelion seed

issues.where: crops 8 and 11, the left edge of the base
issues.what: a scallop seen edge-on sticks out past the silhouette of the base as a flat white blade
issues.fix: set the scallop further into the base or turn it so its curve shows
